newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp shares down after asset sales.
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp shares down after asset sales.

text.p: Ralcorp Holdings Inc shares on Monday traded off 10-1/2 at 12-1/2 to reflect the completion of the sale on January 31 of its branded ready-to-eat cereal and snack mix businesses to General Mills Inc.
The branded cereal and snack deal was valued at $570 million.
"We closed at $23 (a share) on Friday. At the close of business, we completed the deal with General Mills. That was worth $10.75 per share," said Ralcorp spokesman Patrick Farrell.
Subtracting the value of the branded businesses from Ralcorp's close on January 31, the value of the stock going forward is roughly $12.25 a share.
"So it's appropriate," Farrell said of the current stock value.
As part of that deal, Ralcorp shareholders received one share of General Mills stock for about each six Ralcorp shares held.

The purchase price for the Chex and Cookie Crisp cereal brands and Chex Mix snacks included $355 million in General Mills common stock, or about 5.4 million shares, and the assumption by General Mills of $215 million of Ralcorp debt.
